sources.description: The stakeholder's note of 2026-11-08 about the BetaFPV Pavo20 Pro II (sources/stakeholder-pavo.txt of the forum-log directory; aircraft stakeholder-pavo20pro2 of data/flight-logs/inventory.json): motors RCinPower 1303 V3 8000KV; not a datasheet.

Assumed: typical of a 13xx-size 8000 KV whoop motor, chosen for MirageSITL's comparison with the stakeholder's logs; no datasheet we hold states it, and the logs' ESC voltage and current telemetry (15.75 V and 148 A at hover in log 34) is not usable for a fit.

applicability: KV from the stakeholder; every other value assumed for a 1303-size motor of that KV.
